case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption: Nitya Nand v. State of U.P. & Anr.

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided before the Court, so one is correct.

accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to with male pronouns and as the nephew of the victim's brother; Male is supported.

accused_age.reason: No age of the appellant is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the appellant is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the appellant's wealth or class appears.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated.

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Appellant's father was the victim's brother, and prior property enmity is described.

offence_category.reason: The conviction is for murder under s.302 read with s.149 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: The appellant was charged under ss.148 and 302/149 IPC, as stated.

weapon.reason: Country-made pistol, kanta, knives and danda are all described in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony of PW-1 and PW-2 and medical evidence of PW-3 are the relied-on evidence.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the appellant is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court notes no aggravating circumstances; the post-incident point was only a prosecution argument.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted by the court.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches: RI two years and Rs 2,000 fine under s.148; life under s.302/149. Default term omitted, which is minor.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal and affirmed conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding conviction.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court held charges under ss.148 and 302/149 proved beyond reasonable doubt.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment under s.302/149 is the operative sentence.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term sentence applies, so null is correct.

fine_rs.reason: Rs 2,000 is the only fine stated in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summarises the incident and evidence without names, outcome or court references, and within length.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states s.148 punishment and does not state the s.302 punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim was killed, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from multiple incised and stab wounds matches the post-mortem description.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged for the appellant (148 and 302/149), both upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is part of the offence.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment does not find premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: Property dispute and enmity over the will are marked as alleged, matching the judgment's framing.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on PW-1 and PW-2's ocular evidence and PW-3's medical evidence.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found PW-1 and PW-2 categorical and their testimony unshaken in cross-examination.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Court noted that Laxmi Narain, a possible eyewitness, was killed in 1993 and the appellant was an accused in that case.
post_offence_conduct.quote: Laxmi Narain was killed in the year 1993 and in that case one of the accused is the appellant himself.
post_offence_conduct.reason: The court itself noted this later killing and the appellant's role as accused when explaining the non-examination of Laxmi Narain.

custody_duration.reason: The judgment does not state the appellant's time in custody.

bail_history.reason: The judgment states bail was rejected when leave was granted on 30.06.2014.

trial_duration.reason: All four dates match the judgment: offence 08.09.1992, trial 20.01.1997, HC 27.09.2012, SC 04.09.2024.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondents match the appearances section.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, crime number, chargesheet date of 13.10.1992 and completed trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Court noted the scribe Kuldeep and Laxmi Narain were not examined and no pistol or cartridge was recovered; it did not list the blood sample.
procedural_irregularity.quote: It is true that there are certain lacunae in the prosecution. The scribe Kuldeep was not examined.
procedural_irregularity.reason: The blood-sample point comes from cross-examination, not the court's lacunae list; the court did not expressly call them non-fatal.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and Supreme Court dismissal are all accurately recorded.

prosecution_argument.reason: Motive, common object, overt act, non-recovery, medical support and Laxmi Narain's death are all State arguments.

defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments on no injuries, no recovery, omitted witnesses and suspicion/benefit of doubt are accurately stated.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied s.149 vicarious liability and held no overt act need be imputed to the member.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Krishnappa, Vinubhai Ranchhodbhai Patel and Yunis cases with citations match the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court did not give sentencing reasoning; it simply dismissed the appeal, so Not applicable fits.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court weighed no aggravating factors itself.

other_sentence_order.reason: No compensation, directions or other orders are made; the appeal is simply dismissed.
